dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, stippled perimeters with high-contrast white boundaries. These structures show a distinct gradient transition from the dark primary coat to a lighter interior, often punctuated by a dark central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high spatial density of localized white pixel clusters is concentrated along the lower posterior-lateral margin. These asymmetrical blobs appear as solid high-intensity speckling and lack an internal radial gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent mid-lateral 'O' structures form an obtuse scalene triangle. Two smaller, high-contrast markings situated more dorsally form a linear segment oriented roughly parallel to the dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, diffuse field of light-grey pigmentation is situated on the posterior flank, acting as a substrate for several smaller, low-definition ring patterns.
